quote: A wheat-flour bakery; flour is handled openly throughout, so airborne and surface gluten cross-contact is unavoidable. No gluten-free production documented.
found: 「ベーカリー Rotiの店内に入ると、親しみやすい落ち着ける空間。そして焼きたてパンの香ばしい良い香りがします。パンはお店の中央と窓側にたくさん陳列されていました。」 plus 「ベーカリー Rotiには購入したパンを店内で食べられるイートインスペースがあります」. The article names only wheat breads (フレンチトースト, ロールパン, フランスパン生地のフランフラン) and says nothing about gluten-free anything.
note: Claim stands, but trim the unevidenced half: the article never enters the kitchen, so "flour is handled openly throughout" is inference — what IS documented is open display of baked bread across the sales floor plus an eat-in area. Also note the source is a Hiroshima estate agent's blog covering TWO bakeries; the 「小麦はカナダ産1cw」 line belongs to ル・ミトロン, not Roti — do not let that migrate into this record.

quote: Breads and fillings include dairy, egg, meat, and seafood; no separation from animal ingredients is documented.
found: 「ちょっと珍しいなと思ったパンが、カニクリームがおいしそうな ずわいがに 。クリームチーズとオレンジをあわせた クリームチーズとオレンジ 。スモークチーズとポテトサラダをあわせた 士幌ポテト。」 and 「フランスパン生地にバターを練り込み、シロップがぬられているフランフラン」; the shop's most popular item is フレンチトースト.
note: Dairy (cream cheese, smoked cheese, butter), seafood (snow-crab cream) and egg (French toast, potato salad) are all on the page; MEAT is not — no meat bread is named in the Roti section. Drop "meat" or evidence it separately. vegan: ask is the right call for a bakery whose every documented item is animal-containing.

quote: The kitchen is built around fermented foods and a body-friendly, health-conscious concept, so wholesome ingredients are a stated focus.
found: Page title: 「【BioGaia TALKS紙屋町東駅2分】お食事で健康に◎発酵食品を取り入れた身体に優しい"腸活"メニューを満喫」; body: 「北欧スウェーデン生まれのバイオガイアが手がける、親子で楽しむ菌活カフェです。L.ロイテリ菌メニューと緑あふれる癒しの空間で、心とからだを優しくいたわります。」
http: 200 (plain curl); Shopify-hosted, text present in the shell
note: Verbatim support — fermented food (発酵食品/菌活/L.ロイテリ菌) and body-friendly health concept are both the operator's own words. Trading confirmed: 平日11:00-18:00 / 土日祝11:00-17:00, 定休日 毎週月, © 2026. Caveat for the GF layer: a 発酵食品 concept is a gluten RISK signal, not a safe one (miso, shoyu, amazake, koji), so gf: ask is correct and must not drift upward on this citation.

quote: Okonomiyaki is cooked on a shared teppan griddle alongside wheat batter and wheat-based noodles; no gluten-free handling is documented.
found: Review 「うどんにして失敗、そばにすべきだった〜 … そばを寸胴鍋で茹でてから鉄板で焼いています。」 and 「店内はカープのポスターが貼られたクリーム色の壁、オープンキッチンでコンパクトな…」; genre お好み焼き, keyword tags include 小麦 and 広島風.
http: 200 (s.tabelog.com with iPhone UA); desktop tabelog.com also 200 on plain curl (212 KB)

quote: Hiroshima okonomiyaki sauce is wheat-based, and standard soy sauce contains wheat; no gluten-free sauce is indicated.
method: 1 plain fetch + 2 mobile-host fetch with iPhone UA; cross-checked the venue's own Okonomimura page via 3 Wayback
note: The Tabelog page says nothing about soy sauce or okonomiyaki sauce; the only sauce token on it is the word ウスターソース inside the auto-generated review keyword cloud, which evidences nothing about what the shop uses. The venue's own menu page (Okonomimura) names no sauce brand either. Either drop the venue-specific framing and cite the manufacturer directly, or leave the claim as generic-category reasoning and mark it as such. Otafuku's own product page IS citable for the general fact: https://www.otafuku.co.jp/product/detail/995.html lists 醤油 in the ingredients and 小麦 as an allergen.

quote: The single griddle is used for pork, egg, and bonito-finished dishes, so cross-contact with animal products is unavoidable.
found: Okonomimura's own 文ちゃん menu page: 「スタンダードお好み焼き（肉・玉子）麺なし」「お肉たっぷりスペシャル（肉W・玉子・そば又はうどん）」「お薦めシーフード全部入（肉・玉子・えび・いか・そば又はうどん）」, teppan list 「ホルモン鉄板焼き／ぶたみみ鉄板焼き／豚ロース／とんとろ／ゲソ鉄板焼き／ほたて鉄板焼き」, and 「そばはその日の生麺をその都度ゆでて使います」.
http: cited Tabelog 200 but silent on pork/egg/bonito (only the keyword cloud 鳥/ホタテ/すじ煮込み); okonomimura.jp is DOWN — curl to both port 80 and 443 timed out on three attempts; served instead from https://web.archive.org/web/20251012234917/http://okonomimura.jp/floor/2f-fumichean.html (200)
method: 1 plain fetch + 2 iPhone-UA mobile host + 3 Wayback Machine
note: Claim is true but mis-cited: pork and egg are in EVERY standard okonomiyaki on the shop's own menu (肉・玉子), which the Tabelog page never states. Re-point this claim at the Okonomimura page — but note that host is currently unreachable, so cite the Wayback snapshot. BONITO IS NOT EVIDENCED anywhere: drop it. Sibling record check — this is a live-link defect that will hit every Okonomimura tenant record in the dataset, not just 文ちゃん.

quote: 赤米とほうれん草の豆乳リゾットはグルテンフリーで、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガンの人でも食べられると複数媒体で紹介されている。
found: 「赤米とほうれん草の豆乳リゾット 830円（税別）／お野菜たっぷりのリゾットは、グルテンフリー。ベジタリアンの方やヴィーガンの方も食べることができるので、外国人観光客にも人気なんだとか！」
note: Verbatim, dish name included — but 「複数媒体で」 is an overstatement: this is ONE town magazine, and the wording 「なんだか」 marks it as hearsay from the shop rather than an operator statement. Two live gluten hazards the quote hides: the same paragraph says 「お味噌ベースの味付け」 — western-Japan miso is frequently 麦味噌 (barley) — and the article is dated 2019.10.25, seven years stale. Keep gf: ask; DO NOT promote to options on this citation. Rewrite 「複数媒体で」 as 「ペコマガ（2019年）で」.

quote: 野菜をたっぷり使った健康志向のメニューで、外国人観光客にも人気と記載されている。

quote: All dishes are cooked on a shared teppan used for pork, beef, seafood, and egg; no vegan preparation area is documented.
found: 「看板メニューの「ちんちくりん焼き」／牛の中落ち部分を使用！「しょぶり焼」／王道の組合せ「明太子チーズ焼き」等々。その他、海鮮やホルモン焼きもございます！」 and 「当店に来たらまず「ちんちくりん焼き」をどうぞ！目玉焼きやイカ天などが入った、お好み焼きの王道スタイルです。」

Strictly, the word 豚 does not appear — ホルモン焼き is the offal item — so either soften "pork" to "offal/beef" or evidence it from the menu page. vegan: no is correct.

quote: The brothless tantanmen is described as having a soy-sauce-based seasoning, and Japanese soy sauce is typically brewed with wheat.
found: 「川菜味さんの汁なし担々麺です。使用されている麺は細い白色麺、タレは醤油がベースになっているようです。」
method: 1 plain fetch + Yahoo Japan search for trading status
note: Supported, but weakly: 「ようです」 is the blogger guessing, not the shop stating, and the post is dated 2014-04-11 — twelve years old. The bigger gluten fact is in the SAME sentence and missing from the record: 「使用されている麺は細い白色麺」, i.e. wheat noodles, which matter far more to a celiac than the tare. Also add 「専門店のように醤油類が置いてなくて」 (no table soy sauce). Trading: Tabelog 中国料理 川菜味 (広島駅/四川料理, 3.46, 161 reviews, 定休日 月曜日) shows no 閉店 marker. CAUTION for future agents — a same-named 中国料理 川菜味 in Funabashi, Chiba closed 2026-03-15; that is a DIFFERENT business and must not be merged into this record.

found: 「毎日でも食べたくなる中華そばは昭和26年、先代からの味を引継ぎ…醤油ベースで12時間以上掛け煮込んだスープ、3週間寝かせた熟成されたこだわりの秘伝のタレ。」
note: Soy-sauce base is the operator's own wording. The noodle half is inference — the page says 中華そば/ラーメン but never 小麦; 中華麺 is definitionally wheat, so the claim is sound, but flag it as category knowledge rather than sourced. Trading confirmed: live coupons, 深夜3時まで営業, 創業68年.

quote: Broth is a pork-bone (tonkotsu) and soy stock and many dishes contain pork, so vegan diners cannot be accommodated.
found: Menu on the cited page: 「チャーシューメン」「もやしチャーシュー」「豚足」「豚耳」「広島名物 せんじがら」「鶏唐揚げ」「おでん 牛すじ」「広島名物 カキフライ」「広島名物 牛コウネ塩焼き」.
method: 1 plain fetch + Yahoo Japan search to test the tonkotsu attribution
note: The pork conclusion is overwhelmingly supported by the shop's own menu (pig trotters, pig ears, char siu, せんじがら = fried pork offal). But the word 豚骨 does NOT appear anywhere on the cited page — the operator says only 醤油ベース. The tonkotsu attribution is real (multiple independent Tabelog/blog reviewers describe 「豚骨醤油ベースのスープ」/「昔ながらの醤油豚骨スープ」) but needs its own source or should be dropped. Do not let an unsourced stock description ride along inside an otherwise well-evidenced claim.

No allergen or gluten-free statement anywhere on the site. Trading confirmed: 江波南3-4-1 (matches the Eba honten), 11:30-13:30 / 18:00-23:00, 定休日 1・12・13・26日, latest notice 2025.06.10 「営業時間の変更のお知らせ 江波店」.
